```yaml
name: i18n Check
on:
  push:
    branches: [develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [develop]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  i18n-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Cache Maven dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-maven-

      - name: Build project
        run: mvn clean install -DskipTests -Dspotless.check.skip=true

      - name: Check for i18n issues
        run: |
          # Find all Java files with internationalization strings
          find . -name "*.java" -type f | xargs grep -l "Bundle\|MessageFormat\|ResourceBundle" | head -20
          
          # Check for missing translations in properties files
          find . -name "*.properties" -type f | while read prop_file; do
            echo "Checking $prop_file for missing keys..."
            # Simple check for common i18n patterns
            grep -n "^[^#]*=" "$prop_file" | cut -d'=' -f1 | sort > /tmp/keys_in_$prop_file
          done
          
          # Validate that all i18n keys are properly formatted
          find . -name "*.java" -type f -exec grep -l "message\." {} \; | head -10 | while read java_file; do
            echo "Validating i18n usage in $java_file"
            # Basic syntax check for i18n calls
            grep -n "message\." "$java_file" | grep -v "//" | grep -v "message\.get\|message\.format"
          done

      - name: Report i18n issues
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "❌ i18n issues detected!"
          echo "Please review the output above for any missing or malformed internationalization strings."
          exit 1
```
